questions.question:
35 is related to 70 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 24 is related to 48. To which of the following is 11 related, following the same logic?

 (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

35 is related to 70 → 35 × 2 = 70

And,

24 is related to 48 → 24 × 2 = 48

Similarly,

11 is related to → 11 × 2 = **22** 

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Mr. T starts from Point D and drives 3 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 6 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km, and then turns right and drives 3 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point H. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point D again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:
Given:

Mr. T starts from Point D and drives 3 km towards the east.

He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 6 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km, and then turns right and drives 3 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point H. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a133959371f310c0b05907398c7cd0722faed5612756f6c5ab815482cd53059a.png] 

Thus, Mr. T should drive 2 km (7 km - 4 km - 1 km) in the north direction in order to reach Point D again.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the informationgiven in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logicall follow(s) from the

 statements.

 Statements:

Some water is pink.

All pink are buildings.

All buildings are tall.

 Conclusions:

(I) Some pink is water.

(II) Some buildings are pink.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e576a48b8227c57d034c4e70b3bd8c1017cc76c2ab3ac9714d6616b129d2957.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some pink is water → Follow (As some water is pink. As some part of water is common with pink, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some buildings are pink → Follow (As all pink are buildings. As whole pink comes in building, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
